normative_extracts.quote: The s-maxage response directive indicates that, in shared caches, the maximum age specified by this directive overrides the maximum age specified by either the max-age directive or the Expires header field.

pipeline_phases: Edge PoP Cache Key Lookup (URL + Vary)
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Shared CDN caches evaluate s-maxage and stale-while-revalidate directives to serve static HTML at the edge while coalescing background origin rebuilds and tag-based purges.

production_failures.symptom: User A sees User B's account name on a cached SSR page
production_failures.root_cause: Returning public s-maxage headers on a route that reads session cookies causes the CDN PoP to cache and serve personalized HTML to other users.
production_failures.mitigation: Emit Cache-Control: private, no-store on personalized responses or keep the HTML shell generic and fetch user data client-side.

production_failures.symptom: Origin database CPU spikes to 100% when cache TTL expires
production_failures.root_cause: Hundreds of concurrent requests hit an expired cache key simultaneously without request collapsing or stale-while-revalidate.
production_failures.mitigation: Enable stale-while-revalidate and origin single-flight locking so only one worker regenerates the expired key.
